name: Release Reel
tagline: Every release, cut to the beat: one colour, one word and one screen per new thing.
highlights: The app icon opens the film and the version number lands beside it on bar 2
Each feature floods its own colour room on the downbeat
Six chips cover everything else and fly into the phone, then the call to action on the final hit
bring: Three features: a punch word and a line each
Up to six small changes for And more
